newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Wall maintains Delta buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Wall maintains Delta buy.

text.p: Thai electronics firm Delta Electronics Plc was maintained as a buy by Wall Street Finance and Securities Plc following a recent client visit, the broker said in a report on Friday.
"Despite the recent rise in Delta's price we believe the company's excellent operating prospects and valuation means the stock still has upside potential," the report said.
Delta, which makes computer monitor and power supply units, has seen its stock rise to 141 baht from 59 baht this year.
